entities.name: Arsenal City
entities.description: Jamuraan city-state of the Kipamu League on the northern coast, where its war machines were built.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: Jamuraan alliance whose war machines were built in Arsenal City.

entities.name: Mageta
entities.description: Proud commanding officer of Arsenal City's forces who led a counterattack.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Came to inspect the troops and helped organize the campaign.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Helped organize the campaign against the Keldons.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Helped organize the campaign against the Keldons.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders who defeated Mageta's army and besieged Arsenal City.

entities.name: Kinymu
entities.description: City that sent troops with Arsenal City.

entities.name: Keldon invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Jamuraa during which Arsenal City was besieged.

events.summary: Barrin inspects the troops sent by Arsenal City and Kinymu, commanded by Mageta.
Mageta narrowly survives the Keldons' defeat of his army and returns to Arsenal City.
events.quote: Mageta narrowly survived the subsequent defeat of his army at the hands of the Keldons

events.summary: During the Keldons' siege Mageta leads a counterattack that wins the crucial battle.
events.quote: Mageta led the foot-soldiers in a counterattack

relations.quote: Arsenal City was a Jamuraan city-state which was part of the Kipamu League
